title: JSON Web Token: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic JSON Web Token values built to the documented format appear in 2 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: EdDSA JWT signed locally with the public test key. Syntax and signature are checked offline; no production issuer or trust is implied.
